verdict.rationale: Teller exposes account, balance, transaction and identity data through documented APIs with pagination, so data can be pulled out programmatically. A community user built a third-party script that exports accounts to the open CSV/QIF formats via that API. There is no first-party bulk export or documented offboarding path, and the Sidecar claim concerns switching to Teller, not leaving it. Missing for 10: first-party full-data export, documented open export formats, account-deletion/offboarding docs, published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
